I am a Senior Research Fellow at the [Department of Information Studies](https://www.ucl.ac.uk/information-studies), [University College London (UCL)](https://www.ucl.ac.uk). My research examines how social and spatial interactions shape the outcomes of people and places, drawing on causal inference, spatial analysis, and large-scale population data. I am affiliated with the [UK Data Service](https://ukdataservice.ac.uk), where I work on census origin-destination data infrastructure. I have held earlier appointments at [UCL CeLSIUS](https://www.ucl.ac.uk/population-health-sciences/epidemiology-health-care/research/ucl-research-department-epidemiology-public-health/research/health-and-social-surveys-research-group/studies/celsius), the [Office for National Statistics](https://www.ons.gov.uk), and the [Welsh Government](https://www.gov.wales), and have broad experience with population data (and their metadata) spanning censuses, administrative records, and digital traces, and with their use in research and policy.
